arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: General Katyal argued the case presents unprecedented numbers of perpetrators and victims. He claimed this quantitative difference eclipses past cases.
Ms. Underwood asserted states have longstanding authority to protect land and citizens. She emphasized the right to guard against out-of-state air pollution.
Mr. Keisler contended courts are being asked to perform legislative functions. He described the policy balancing as complex and consequential.
